descriptions.text: Mairmei Mushroom – Alchemy Material. These little guys are quite the trip.

recap.text: Back at base, Carl hands Mordecai the mushrooms he took from the desk in the basement. The system calls them Mairmei Mushroom, an alchemy material that is quite the trip, and Mordecai, who has never seen the strain, takes the batch to study. The camel Henrik says the gnomes drug Wynne, who has grown a tolerance and must be fed more every day. Raw, the mushrooms apparently make people do what you want, unreliably.

beats.headline: Quite the trip
beats.text: Back at base, Carl hands Mordecai the batch of mushrooms he took from the desk in the basement. Mordecai frowns. The system calls them Mairmei Mushroom, alchemy material, and all the description says is that these little guys are quite the trip. Carl assumes a psychedelic; the cookbook has very little on mushrooms. Mordecai is intrigued, because he has never seen this strain, and Carl gives him the batch to study before they open the benefactor boxes.
beats.gist: Carl gives Mordecai the basement mushrooms, a strain he has never seen, to study.

beats.headline: A tolerance for the mushroom
beats.text: The camel who calls himself Henrik explains the collateral that keeps the gnomes from bombing Hump Town: Wynne cooperated for years, until he was moved to the chamber below the town hall and understood his situation had changed. Since then they have had to drug him to force compliance, and it is getting harder. He has grown a tolerance for the mushroom, and they must feed him more every day. Mordecai has not yet worked out what the mushrooms do, but eaten raw they apparently help get people to do what you want. The mind control is not very reliable, but it has worked well enough here.
beats.gist: The camel Henrik says the gnomes drug Wynne with the mushroom, and he now needs more daily.
